Bulk Spinach Powder for Food Manufacturing and Wholesale Supply

Bulk spinach powder from Tradenest Naturals is a fine, dehydrated ingredient made from carefully selected spinach leaves. It is bought by food manufacturers, distributors, importers, foodservice operators and private label brands that want a natural green colour and a recognisable spinach flavour without handling fresh leaves. A dry powder removes the cold storage, trimming and waste that come with fresh spinach, and it weighs and blends easily in batch production. Our standard grade is a spinach powder 80 mesh. Other particle sizes can be discussed if your process needs them. Tradenest Naturals works as a dehydrated spinach powder exporter and bulk dehydrated spinach powder supplier India buyers and overseas importers can deal with directly. We handle both standard and customised B2B orders. You can ask for samples, a technical discussion, a packaging proposal or a quotation based on your volume, destination market, application and target parameters.

Product Overview

Dehydrated Spinach Leaf Powder is produced by cleaning, sorting, drying, grinding and sieving spinach leaves into a uniform, free-flowing powder. Drying brings the moisture down while keeping the natural green colour, the fresh vegetable aroma and the mild leafy taste as far as possible. The powder suits dry premixes, seasoning systems, sauces, soups, snacks, bakery items, beverage blends and other formulations that need a concentrated, shelf-stable spinach ingredient. The standard product is a single-ingredient powder. It has no added salt, sugar, artificial colour or synthetic flavouring, unless a customer has approved a different formulation. Final parameters are checked against the agreed product specification, the purchase order and the requirements of the destination market.

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals follows set process controls so that one batch performs like the next. Incoming spinach leaves are inspected and sorted to remove damaged material and foreign matter. Accepted leaves are washed and then dried under controlled conditions to lower moisture and support storage stability. After drying, the material is milled and passed through a calibrated sieve to reach the target mesh.
  • Raw material selection and incoming inspection
  • Cleaning, sorting and removal of foreign material
  • Controlled dehydration to reduce moisture
  • Grinding and milling to the target particle size
  • Sieving for uniformity, with standard 80 mesh supply
  • Batch coding, food-grade packing and traceability records
If you have particular colour, particle size, moisture or application requirements, we can review the processing parameters with you. Custom grinding, bulk industrial packing, private label retail packing and contract manufacturing are available after a technical review and an agreed order quantity.

Typical Technical Specifications

For bulk supply, the typical specification is a particle size of 80 mesh and a moisture content of not more than 7%. The ingredient is spinach leaf powder only. These are target values and can vary slightly with crop season, processing conditions, packaging and any customer-specific parameters agreed at order stage. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.
  • Mesh: Standard 80 mesh; other sizes on discussion
  • Moisture: Not more than 7%
  • Purity: Single-ingredient dehydrated spinach leaf powder, unless otherwise agreed
  • Appearance: Fine green to dark green, free-flowing powder
  • Flavour: Characteristic spinach flavour with mild vegetal notes
  • Ingredient Declaration: Dehydrated spinach leaf powder
Buyers should confirm any further quality parameters, such as allergen declarations or residue limits, against their own formulation, market rules and regulatory obligations. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter, and we do not claim certifications beyond these. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Documents we provide include the product specification sheet, batch details, packing specifications and the agreed export paperwork before dispatch.

Applications

Wholesale spinach leaf powder is a practical choice wherever a manufacturer needs a shelf-stable spinach ingredient that is easier to store, weigh, ship and blend than fresh produce. It works in both dry and wet food systems, subject to your own recipe trials and process validation. A few practical points help during development. Spinach powder disperses best when it is pre-blended with other dry ingredients such as flour, starch or salt before liquid is added. Its colour can shift towards olive green under long, high heat or in acidic recipes, so trials should cover your real cooking time and pH. In bakery doughs and pasta, it is often added at a few percent of flour weight to give a visible green tone and a mild vegetable taste.
  • Soup, broth, sauce, gravy and instant meal premixes
  • Seasonings, snack coatings, namkeen, pasta and noodle formulations
  • Bakery products, savoury biscuits, crackers, breads and flatbreads
  • Ready-to-cook meals, ready-to-eat foods and dehydrated vegetable mixes
  • Green beverage mixes, smoothie powders and blended vegetable powders
  • Stuffed foods, dips, spreads, dressings and savoury fillings
  • Foodservice recipes for restaurants, hotels, caterers and cloud kitchens
  • Custom dry seasoning blends and private label retail products

Buyer Value

  • Longer storage convenience: The dry format removes the need for a refrigerated fresh spinach supply chain and makes inventory easier to plan.
  • Operational efficiency: A ready-to-use powder simplifies weighing, portioning and batch addition.
  • Consistent supply: Buying in bulk helps manufacturers manage seasonal swings in crop availability and plan production ahead.
  • Cost efficiency: Dry powder cuts the handling, trimming, washing and preparation labour that fresh leaves require.
  • Flexible formulation: The ingredient fits dry mixes, sauces, bakery systems, snack seasonings and beverage concepts.
  • Scalable sourcing: Standard bulk supply, export packing, private label and OEM options suit businesses at different stages of growth.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard packaging uses food-grade, moisture-resistant, tamper-evident materials chosen to suit the order size and the shipping route. Options include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg packs, along with larger bulk bags for manufacturing customers. Stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, printed consumer packs, private label packaging and export outer cartons can also be arranged. Each pack is labelled with the product name, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions and any disclosures required by the destination market. Shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture when the powder stays sealed in suitable packaging and is stored as recommended. Actual shelf life can depend on the packaging barrier, warehouse conditions and transit. Keep the product in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, heat, humidity, strong odours and chemicals. Reseal opened packs promptly and use clean, dry scoops.

MOQ, Samples, and Lead Time

The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for bulk spinach powder is 5 Kg. This makes it practical to run trial batches before committing to larger volumes. Private label packing, custom blends, special mesh sizes and OEM projects may need larger quantities because of raw material planning, production scheduling and packaging set-up. We confirm the final quantity after reviewing the product format, destination, volume and any customisation. Lead time depends on stock on hand, the raw material season, packaging customisation, any testing you request and the export documents involved. We confirm a dispatch schedule once the specification and commercial terms are agreed. To request samples or a quotation, please tell us the volume you need, the intended application, target mesh, packaging preference, destination country and any labelling or documentation needs. Tradenest Naturals will review the details and send a clear, practical supply proposal.

Certifications and Quality Standards

Quality control at Tradenest Naturals covers raw material inspection, moisture monitoring, in-process checks, sieving, packing checks and batch traceability under our FSSAI registration. We do not hold or claim additional third-party certifications for this product. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. If your market needs specific documents, allergen statements or test parameters, please tell us at the enquiry stage so we can confirm what is possible before you order.
